title: Radio
subtitle: Live channel messages meet relational queries.
intro: Subscribe to WebSocket or Redis Pub/Sub endpoints, query buffered messages, and queue replies from DuckDB. The subscription URL identifies the feed throughout its lifecycle; a loopback:// feed needs no server, for tests and offline work.

reference.name: CALL radio_subscribe(url)
reference.description: Open a feed; receive_message_capacity tunes its buffer size.

reference.name: radio_subscriptions()
reference.description: Inspect feeds: transmit counters plus received_messages_queued and _dropped_unseen.

reference.name: radio_received_messages()
reference.description: Read buffered messages across all subscriptions.

reference.name: radio_subscription_received_messages(url)
reference.description: Read the buffer for one subscription URL.

reference.name: CALL radio_listen(first, wait)
reference.description: Wait for arrivals, bounded by an INTERVAL timeout.

reference.name: CALL radio_transmit_message(…)
reference.description: Queue URL, channel, BLOB payload, attempt count and retry interval.

reference.name: CALL radio_unsubscribe(url)
reference.description: Close a feed using the exact subscription URL.

notes.title: A buffer is not durable storage
notes.body: Subscriptions and messages live in process memory. Capacity limits evict older messages, counted in received_messages_dropped_unseen; process exit discards state. Persist records you need in a DuckDB table, deduplicating on subscription_id and message_id.

notes.title: Payloads and delivery
notes.body: message is a BLOB; use decode(message) for UTF-8 text. Transmit calls queue work, so check counters for delivery progress. WebSocket and Redis URLs are refused while enable_external_access is false; loopback:// still works.

examples.title: Subscribe, wait and inspect
examples.caption: Requires a WebSocket endpoint on localhost:8765 that emits UTF-8 text messages.
examples.reason: Requires a configured WebSocket server and waits for network messages.

examples.title: Queue a reply and inspect delivery
examples.caption: Poll until delivery completes before calling radio_unsubscribe.
examples.reason: Sends a message to the configured endpoint and requires delivery inspection.

examples.title: Test offline with loopback://
examples.caption: The transmitted message returns to the same feed: orders, {"value":43}.

assertions: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT decode(message) FROM radio_subscription_received_messages('loopback://t')) = '{"value":43}' AND (SELECT transmit_successes FROM radio_subscriptions() WHERE url = 'loopback://t') = 1 THEN true ELSE error('Radio loopback delivery failed') END;
